reason: A dsh web GUI customization plugin whose primary purpose is themed interface styling with an interactive desktop pet that reacts to agent activity and stores progress locally.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh 网页界面提供三种 Rick and Morty 主题皮肤，以及可根据智能体状态互动并保存进度的桌面宠物。
summaries.en: Adds three Rick and Morty theme skins and an interactive desktop pet to the dsh web GUI, with reactions to agent states and locally stored progress.

capabilities: Applies three selectable GUI theme skins
Provides an interactive desktop pet with selectable characters and agent-state reactions
Stores pet preferences, position, familiarity, task progress, and adventure log in browser localStorage
